title: Perturbed beam-walking task
description: A multimodal dataset of human balance during beam walking and standing on a treadmill-mounted balance beam. It includes synchronized 128-channel EEG, lower leg and neck EMG, EOG, and motion capture. Participants were exposed to visual field rotations in virtual reality or physical side-to-side waist pulls, which allows electrocortical and muscular responses to sensorimotor perturbations to be compared.
methods_description: Participants completed four 10-minute same-day sessions in which they stood or walked at 0.22 m/s on a treadmill-mounted balance beam (2.5 cm tall, 12.7 cm wide). Each session had 150 perturbation events, balanced between directions. The perturbations were either virtual-reality visual field rotations (0.5 s) or side-to-side waist pulls (1 s). Good channel indices and ICA sphere and weight matrices are stored in EEG.etc of each .set file.
